events-note: Bino bintu ebisomeddwa, si kusalawo ku bukodyo. Obubonero bw'obudde bulaga obudde obujjuvu bwa demo, si butundu bwa vidiyo.
explain-combat: Ebivudde mu lutalo ebikakasiddwa, nga mulimu okutta n’embeera y’omuzannyo eyawandiikibwa.
explain-context: Enkyukakyuka z’embeera y’omuzannyo n’okuteeka model wakati. Omuwendo omubi guyinza okuva mu kuteeka wakati, so si mu kikolwa kibi.
explain-cross-family: Kikozesebwa wamu ku bika ebibi; tekigabibwa ku bintu ebyaliwo kinnoomu.
explain-death-related: Enkosa y’okufa eyawandiikibwa. Okufa kya mazima, si nsobi ya bukodyo mu bwangu.
explain-direct-harm: Obuvune obukakasiddwa ku bannaakibinja, obukendeezeddwa nga enkosa ya H2 tennakozesebwa.
explain-final-family-only: Enkosa esembayo eri ku mutendera gw’ekika gwokka.
explain-objectives: Ebikolwa bya bbomu oba abawambe ebikakasiddwa, n’ensalo za model we kyetaagisa.
explain-support: Assists, flashes n’obuyambi obulala eri bannaakibinja obukakasiddwa.
explain-transform-context-center: Okuteeka embeera wakati okusinziira ku musingi gwa model
explain-transform-negative: Okutereeza ebika ebibi awamu mu ngeri etali ya layini
important-fast-trade-summary: Yatta omuzigu oluvannyuma lwa sekonda {{seconds}} nga munne amaze okufa.
important-moments-note: Multikill ne trade ebikakasiddwa byokka bye biragibwa. Okutta okwa bulijjo, obuvune n’ensobi ezitakakasiddwa tebiteekebwamu.
insight-no-weakness: Tewali bunafu obuzuuliddwa okusinziira ku mbeera mu kwekenneenya okuweereddwa.
insight-trades: Bw'oba ogezaako okuyingira, munno abe kumpi asobole okutta akusse.
loss-context: Weekenneenye ekitundu ky'omuzannyi mu byavudde mu muzannyo, nga mw'otwalidde obuyambi bwe obulungi. Okuwangulwa kwokka tekukakasa musango.
no-events: Tewali bintu byawandiikibwa ebikwatagana n'okulonda kuno.
no-important-moments: Tewali multikill oba trade ekakasiddwa eyazuuliddwa ku muzannyi ono.
non-live: Ebweru w'ekiseera kya lawundi eri mu kugenda
not-found: Omuzannyi ono tali mu muzannyo guno.
rating-absent: Omuzannyi teyabaddewo mu round nnyingi nnyo ezikakasiddwa.
rating-explanation-note: Ebintu ebikakasiddwa binnyonnyola obujulizi obuyinza okugattibwa mu bwesigwa bwokka. Emisingi n’enkyukakyuka ezitali za layini bisigala byawufu era tebiddamu kugabibwa ku bintu ebyaliwo.
rating-noncausal: Okupima kuno okw’okwetaba okutannapimibwa bulungi si bukakafu bwa musango gwa taktiki oba kigendererwa. Obulabe obutereevu kika kimu kyokka, si musango.
strengths-unavailable: Amaanyi n'obunafu bw'omuntu byetaaga okwekenneenya embeera. Tewali kusalawo kuva ku K/D/A.
unknown-context: Ebyava mu muzannyo tebikakasiddwa. Ebikolwa ebiriwo biragibwa awatali kipimo ekisinziira ku byava mu muzannyo.
win-context: Weekenneenye omugaso gw'omuzannyi mu buwanguzi, n'ebikolwa ebisobola okulongoosebwa.
